PushoverAcceptance.description:
Acceptance of the members at the target displacement (``fem.acceptance``). Method
``fibreStrain``: each fibre's strain at the member's end sections against a share of the
strain at which its material loses strength.

deformationShare.description: A member's deformation may reach at most this × the deformation at which it fails (gravity loss, or strength below residualStrengthShare).
deformationShare.title: Deformationshare

residualStrengthShare.description: Strength (share of the peak) below which the component has failed.
residualStrengthShare.title: Residualstrengthshare

reinforcementFractureStrain.description: Strain at which a reinforcing bar is taken as lost (fracture or buckling): the fibre model's bars do not degrade.
reinforcementFractureStrain.title: Reinforcementfracturestrain

steelFractureStrain.description: Strain at which a structural steel fibre is taken as lost (fracture or local buckling): the fibre model's steel does not degrade.
steelFractureStrain.title: Steelfracturestrain

note.description: Why the values are what they are.
note.title: Note

PushoverAcceptance.title: PushoverAcceptance

PushoverProcedure.description:
How the pushover is run: the lateral load pattern the code requires, how far the control
point is pushed and the no-drop rule of the capacity curve.

loadPattern.description: Lateral load pattern the code requires (firstMode: proportional to the fundamental mode's shape times the masses, applied at the centres of mass).
loadPattern.title: Loadpattern

pushToTarget.description: Push the control point to at least this × the target displacement.
pushToTarget.title: Pushtotarget

noDropToTarget.description: The base shear may not drop in any step up to this × the target displacement.
noDropToTarget.title: Nodroptotarget

expectedStrengths.description: Material strengths of the nonlinear model: nominal (never above the expected strengths the code caps them at) or expected.
expectedStrengths.title: Expectedstrengths

note.description: Why the values are what they are.
note.title: Note

PushoverProcedure.title: PushoverProcedure

TargetDisplacement.description:
The target displacement of the control point (``fem.pushover_target``). Method
``coefficient``: a bilinear fit of the capacity curve, the effective period
Te = T1·√(K1/Ke) and δt = C0·C1·Sa(Te)·(Te/2π)²·g.

bilinearFitShare.description: The bilinear curve's first segment meets the capacity curve at this × the effective yield strength.
bilinearFitShare.title: Bilinearfitshare

spectrumR.description: R of the spectrum Sa is read from (1: the real, unreduced spectrum).
spectrumR.title: Spectrumr

spectrumImportance.description: I of the spectrum Sa is read from.
spectrumImportance.title: Spectrumimportance

c1PeriodLimit.description: C1 = 1 where Te exceeds this corner period of the site class.
c1PeriodLimit.title: C1Periodlimit

c1Period.description: The corner period Ts of the C1 formula C1 = [1 + (Rd - 1)·Ts/Te] / Rd.
c1Period.title: C1Period

minimumRd.description: Rd is taken as at least this (below 1 the structure stays elastic and the C1 formula has no meaning).
minimumRd.title: Minimumrd
